purpose: Source-lock and derive the exact homogeneous q=0 quadratic scalar/global-lapse block on the frozen candidate using the fixed C8 P(X_U) action. Determine the homogeneous lapse denominator and reduced kinetic coefficient before any hard-hard-homogeneous cubic vertex calculation.

source_lock.homogeneous_spatial_operators: R3=0, D_i R3=0, D_i Theta_U=0; alpha6 and mixed spatial-gradient carriers vanish in the homogeneous quadratic block

required_derivation: write A=(3/2)Mstar^2(1-3lambda_HL) for the homogeneous gravitational kinetic coefficient
expand N P(X0/N^2) through n_0^2 and derive D=X P_X+2X^2 P_XX
use K_phys=2X(P_X+2XP_XX)=2D and the fixed-action identity K_phys=2Mstar^2 M_K^2
use only background Hamiltonian/tadpole equations to cancel zeta_0 n_0 and zeta_0^2 mass terms
expose Delta_N=AH^2+D as the exact global-lapse algebraic denominator
when Delta_N is nonzero derive n_0=AH dot(zeta_0)/Delta_N and Q_hom=A D/Delta_N
compare symbolically with the punctured finite-y kinetic coefficient D/H^2 and do not assume equality
outcome_policy: PASS if the homogeneous quadratic block and denominator are derived exactly. A zero Delta_N is a scientifically valid singular-branch result, not a reason to alter the action. This gate does not yet interpret Q_hom as a local particle ghost/no-ghost criterion because s6fJ classified q=0 as a background/global sector.
forbidden: using the finite-y momentum constraint n=dot(zeta)/H at exact q=0
choosing M_K or lambda_HL to force a desired sign
next_if_pass: C10.65s6fL: derive the hard-hard-homogeneous cubic source for (zeta_0,n_0) from the same fixed action, including the n=2 alpha6(X) carrier and hard-mode shift already reduced at finite k, then compute the exact q=0 virtual exchange or prove the global constraint removes it.
non_claims: not a local homogeneous ghost theorem
